role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer I, Search Ads
company_profile: Etsy is a global online marketplace connecting buyers with independent sellers of handmade, vintage and creative goods, and its Search Ads team builds ML for sponsored search.
title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years training, deploying and monitoring production ML systems across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Works across information retrieval and NLP, from cross-encoder re-ranking over dense retrieval and a reranker for a recommendation system to Sentence-BERT embeddings, alongside classical ML with LightGBM and XGBoost. Owns work from design to delivery with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Marketplace Ad Relevance Ranking
bullets: Built a two-stage ad retrieval and ranking system for sponsored search on an online marketplace, pairing Sentence-BERT embedding retrieval with a LightGBM click model and cross-encoder re-ranking.
Evaluated ranking quality offline with NDCG and simulated A/B comparisons against a baseline, then served the models behind a FastAPI service with MLflow tracking and monitoring.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Machine Learning Engineer I role on the Search Ads team. My work sits in retrieval, ranking and NLP: cross-encoder re-ranking over dense retrieval, a reranker for a recommendation system, and Sentence-BERT models in production. The thread through all of it is putting the right result in front of the right person.

Etsy's ads help small sellers get their listings seen by buyers, which makes relevance matter to real businesses, not only to a revenue line. I like working on that kind of problem. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Dublin together and settle there long term.

At Optum I built a reranker on an existing recommendation system that raised renewal conversion by 2%. At Viavi I deployed a LightGBM system with FastAPI and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%, and kept it monitored in production. I would bring both habits, careful ranking and careful operation, to your ads funnel.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that every model has an end user, and that their experience is the real test. I would be glad to talk about the role.
